scope: Pure Windows child-environment candidate plus exact pip temporary-lifecycle diagnosis/amendment proposal

Use fixed null pip config and no-autoload/no-user-site/bytecode settings; only source-build profile gets exact PyYAML flags/epoch.

review_questions: Does the pure mapping match the prepared environment policy and fail closed on the tested lexical/profile boundary?
Are synthetic parent overrides excluded without capturing real values, and are filesystem/process/descendant limitations explicit?
Does the exact upstream source support the temporary-lifecycle diagnosis and the unadopted, bounded amendment without asserting a nonexistent --no-clean solution?
